# Quantitative & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Yahoo Finance Strategy Lifecycle & Backtesting Control Panel

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability across strategy catalog, mark-to-market backtesting, provider isolation, and full-screen Web UI ergonomics
**Created**: 2026-10-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all editable strategy parameters and their canonical defaults explicitly documented for both `darwin_trend` and `darwinx_zero_trader`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are both single-asset and multi-asset/sector batch selection requirements specified for the Strategy Control Panel? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK003 Are all required KPI summary metrics (Net Profit $ & %, Realized/Unrealized PnL $ & %, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Max Drawdown, Sharpe, Latest Signal) enumerated in the specification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity & Quantitative Precision

- [x] CHK004 Is the zero-lookahead alignment rule for Weekly Heikin-Ashi (`w1_ha_color_prev1`, `w1_ha_color_prev2`) unambiguously defined for `darwinx_zero_trader` on Yahoo Finance data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 Is the portfolio capital allocation and timeline alignment formula (`initial_balance / N`, `ffill`, and `fillna(capital_k)`) explicitly specified for multi-asset backtests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK006 Is the accounting relationship between `initial_balance`, `realized_pnl`, `unrealized_pnl`, and `final_equity` mathematically specified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency & Isolation

- [x] CHK007 Are top-level Web navigation tab requirements (`Darwinex MT5`, `Yahoo Finance`, `Strategy Lifecycle`) and removal of the legacy `StrategySidebar` consistent across user stories and functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §US-3, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Do all requirements enforce strict isolation between `data/yahoo_finance.db` and Darwinex Zero MT5 `data/historical_rates.db`? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, Constitution Principle VI]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for warm-up bars prior to `from_date` so indicator warm-up does not consume bars inside the requested trading window? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK010 Are zero-trade and zero-loss boundary conditions specified so ratio metrics (`Profit Factor`, `Sharpe Ratio`, `Win Rate`) never produce `NaN` or division-by-zero errors? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK011 Is the behavior specified when a multi-asset batch includes tickers with zero historical bars in the requested date range (`NO_DATA` status without aborting the batch)? [Coverage, Spec §US-2 Scenario 3]

## Measurability & Acceptance Criteria

- [x] CHK012 Are latency targets (`< 500ms` single-asset, `< 3s` 25-asset batch) objectively measurable in automated/local verification? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
